cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.description: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.description: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Each of its nine tails is imbued with supernatural power, and it can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.description: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When it trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Phione
cards.description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.description: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.description: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.description: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.description: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Servine
cards.description: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: It stares intently at everything. It can become so obsessed with watching that it doesn't notice attacks.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.description: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others

cards.name: Solosis
cards.description: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.description: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.description: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.description: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.description: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.description: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: When its opponent can't be paralyzed, it contorts itself with unexpected speed and flops away.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

cards.name: Audino
cards.description: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

cards.name: Servine
cards.description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: It glides on its outstretched membrane while shocking foes with the electricity stored in the pouches on its cheeks.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.description: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
